newsitem.title: CHINA: China metallurgical industry '97 profits seen down.
newsitem.headline: China metallurgical industry '97 profits seen down.

text.p: Profits of China's metallurgical industry could decline in 1997, but its expenditures are expected to increase, the Market Daily said on Monday.

The metallurgical industry saw its first quarter profits slip compared with the year-ago period due to rising coal and electricity prices and falling steel prices, the newspaper said. It did not elaborate.
The Ministry of Metallurgical Industry has set a profit target of no less than the 3.9 billion yuan ($470 million) recorded last year, it said.
The ministry has instructed state-owned metallurgical enterprises to cut costs, focus on new markets, adjust product structure and strengthen management.
Steel output was 25.43 million tonnes in the first quarter, up 5.4 percent from the same 1996 period.
